widget.description: Complete visualization widget definition for create or full replacement. Omitted fields are dropped on replacement. source references the saved visualization { id, name }. Upsert defines the widget only; it neither places it nor changes existing placements.

id.description: Existing widget ID. Required when fully replacing a persisted widget; omit when creating a widget. Never invent this value. An unsaved draft widget has no ID and may be replaced by matching widget.name.

name.description: Stable widget key, e.g. "viz_1". On persisted replacement, it must match the widget identified by id.

actions.description: Optional click/select interactions. Full per-type shape: _shared-widget-fields.json.

dynamicTokens.description: Optional dynamic value bindings keyed by token name. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json.

shareState.description: Whether the widget shares interaction state.

receiveFilterSource.description: Which published filters this widget listens to. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json#/receiveSources/receiveFilterSource.

receiveParameterSource.description: Which published parameters this widget listens to. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json#/receiveSources/receiveParameterSource.
